topic_title: 夏季签约球员与梅西一同跻身美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）高薪球员之列：从联赛薪资公布中得出的要点
lead_source_title: Summer signings join Lionel Messi among MLS’s top earners: Takeaways from the league’s salary release
lead_source_summary: How much in player salaries did it take to earn a point in the 2026 MLS regular season? The latest batch of salaries lends some insight Lionel Messi has closer company at the top of MLS’s list of highest-paid players, thanks to another pair of former Barcelona attackers. The Inter Miami captain is still comfortably the league’s top earner, on a guaranteed compensation of $28.3m. Robert Lewandowski (Chicago Fire) and Antoine Griezmann (Orlando City) have entered the list with the second and third highest wages, while Atlanta United’s Breel Embolo, another summer signing, ranks fifth on a guaranteed compensation of $10.8m. Second-year LAFC forward Son Heung-min sits fourth on $11.2m. Casimiro, who joined Messi in Miami at the end of his contract with Manchester United, is his team’s fourth top-earner with a guaranteed compensation of $3.54m. This comes after Miami announced his signing as a non-designated player to the surprise of some as the Brazilian arrived on a Bosman transfer rather than a loan-with-purchase, as Rodrigo De Paul had last summer, to keep Miami rules compliant. The MLS Players’ Association lists Casimiro on a base salary of $896,004. Continue reading...
